dialogues.speaker: Fournier
dialogues.text: Right you are! Have you heard of the famous Hotel Debord? I used to be a patissier there.

dialogues.speaker: Fournier
dialogues.text: Some time ago, we had a guest from Natlan. I learned about the Easybreeze Holiday Resort from him.

dialogues.speaker: Fournier
dialogues.text: It seemed like an excellent opportunity to promote Fontaine's desserts, so I decided to set up a stall here.

dialogues.speaker: Fournier
dialogues.text: That Natlanese guest's name was Tzompantli, I believe. I think he's got his own shop at the market. You should check it out — if you're interested.
